phrase_scope: whole-input English matches; not a general language model
pending: Only immediately preceding prompt; completed source episode; confirmation must be explicit; no generic yes
one_time: Never reusable; overrides retained guidance for current request
provenance: Original request digest, pending source turn and episode in existing ledger
mode_off: No natural feedback promotion or extra guidance
controls: Existing slash commands plus pause learning and resume learning
forget: Existing disable-reuse controls only; physical deletion not implemented
